output.title: PixelMuse: AI Product Photo Editor
output.tagline: Clean, upscale & batch-process product images instantly
output.description_short: Turn messy supplier photos into catalog-ready images with AI. 4x upscale, background cleanup, and batch processing for e-commerce stores.
output.description_long:
Supplier photos in, catalog-ready images out. PixelMuse uses AI fine-tuned for product photography to clean up messy backgrounds, correct lighting, and upscale images 4x — without blurring text or fabric textures.

Perfect for Shopify merchants and agencies managing 200–20,000 SKUs. Process entire catalogs overnight with the batch API and CSV workflow. Apply store-level presets to keep every image visually consistent across your listings.

Trusted by 3 Shopify agencies in their standard workflow. During beta, users processed over 38,000 images — with a 12MP upscale taking just 9 seconds. No more manual Photoshop or generic AI tools that ruin product details.

Start with 50 free credits. Pay only $0.04 per image after that.

faq.q: How is this different from Topaz or Magnific?
faq.a: PixelMuse is tuned specifically for product photos — it preserves label text and fabric details that generic AI tools often blur or repaint.

faq.q: Can I process hundreds of images at once?
faq.a: Yes. Use the batch API or CSV upload to process entire catalogs overnight, not one image at a time.
Not yet in the app store, but many Shopify agencies already use PixelMuse in their workflow. API access is fully documented.
